tree.heading: Board of Directors.—
tree.text: The board of directors and the responsibilities of the board are as provided in the articles of incorporation.

tree.heading: Officers.—
tree.text: The officers and the election of officers are as provided in the articles of incorporation.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 240105(a)36:3106.Oct. 30, 1984, Pub. L. 98–584, §§ 6, 7, 98 Stat. 3097. 240105(b)36:3107. The words “and in conformity with the laws of the States in which it is incorporated” in 36:3106 and “and shall be in conformity with the laws of the States in which it is incorporated” in 36:3107 are omitted as unnecessary.
